datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule across Mauritania in 2013. The classifications were spatially mapped to administrative and livelihood zones to represent acute food insecurity phases, which serve as post-event or ongoing impact assessments of food security status.
